contributions.original_prompts:
New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-mobile-custom-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-inapp-custom-payment-methods-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-custom-payment-methods.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/custom-payment-methods`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/custom-payment-methods, the November 7 capture introduces custom payment methods for the Mobile Payment Element and lists iOS, Android and React Native variants (new raw lines 5-15). Platform prerequisites, SDK contracts and transaction states come from the April 22 capture. It instructs merchants to use a Stripe account and existing platform Payment Sheet integration, create a named and branded method in Dashboard, then configure the PaymentSheet handler with its cpmt_ method type (old raw lines 18-54, 211-230 and 421-476). The handler receives the chosen method and any collected billing details and relays completion, cancellation or failure from the external PSP to the platform UI. The merchant processes and finalizes the payment outside Stripe and remains responsible for applicable laws and the PSP agreement (old raw lines 8-12, 60-124, 274-331 and 480-550). The optional server example creates a separate type:custom PaymentMethod using the cpmt_ type and reports a Payment Record with the external processor reference and an example guaranteed outcome (old raw lines 153-199). source-stripe-inapp-custom-payment-methods.md preserves off-Stripe processing and optional reporting but omits the base integration prerequisites and explicit embedded UI boundary and overstates the sample beta version as a requirement.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/custom-payment-methods, the November capture keeps the topic and replaces three detailed bodies with navigation links (new raw lines 5-15). No product change is documented by that parent index. Preserve the April 22 PaymentSheet and platform scopes, the Android FlowController instruction to report canceled if exiting before confirmation, and React Native resultHandler. Qualify the historical iOS prose failure(error:) versus the .failed(error:) Swift example and the Android PaymentSheet prose onCustomPaymentMethodResult() versus the examples' handleCustomPaymentMethodResult() (old raw lines 64-93, 276-312 and 480-550). In source-stripe-inapp-custom-payment-methods.md and its Custom Payment Methods and In-App Payments routes, keep PaymentSheet result types distinct from the embedded guide and link the embedded source reciprocally. Date the optional server reporting SDK example with 2026-03-25.dahlia and invoice_partial_payments_beta=v3 (old raw lines 153-199). A separate November Report a payment API reference uses 2026-10-28.endive and inline custom payment method details in its request example (raw/stripe-api-payment-record-report-2026-11-07.md lines 7-23 and 59-87). Qualify the universal beta wording on the mobile summary and general recording concept while retaining both API contexts. A PaymentSheet callback reports the external PSP result to the UI, and the server Payment Record records the supplied outcome. Neither proves Stripe processed, settled or independently guaranteed the external funds.
